# BizChefs

> Full-service digital and technology partner for founders, small businesses, growing companies, and established organizations. We deliver digital strategy, high-performance web development, graphic design, brand identity systems, social media creative support, and dependable ongoing website care.

- Website: https://bizchefs.com
- Location: Egypt & Global Remote Delivery
- Contact: contact@bizchefs.com
- Telephone / WhatsApp: +20 128 171 9903
- Full Context Dossier: https://bizchefs.com/llms-full.txt
- Official Repository: https://github.com/diamondsdev/Bizchef

## Core Offerings & Engagement Models

- [Website Design & Development](https://bizchefs.com/services/web-development): Bespoke Next.js 15 App Router websites, custom web apps, e-commerce stores, and high-converting landing pages. Pricing from $300 to $25,000+ based on scope.
- [Monthly Website & Digital Care](https://bizchefs.com/pricing): Proactive maintenance retainers, continuous uptime monitoring, monthly dependency updates, and scheduled creative updates. Plans start at $100/mo (Essential), $250/mo (Growth), and $600/mo (Dedicated).
- [Graphic Design & Brand Identity](https://bizchefs.com/services/graphic-design): Logo suites, visual design systems, brand guidelines, social media templates, and marketing collateral. Package scopes from $500.
- [Digital Strategy & Architecture Advisory](https://bizchefs.com/contact): Complimentary initial scoping sessions, codebase audits, and comprehensive technical blueprints ($450, credited toward development).

## Commercial Delivery Standards

- **50/50 Milestone Protection**: We do not demand 100% upfront payment for custom builds. 50% deposit upon kickoff, 50% upon final staging sign-off before production domain launch.
- **100% Client Code & IP Ownership**: Clients receive complete ownership of all repositories, domain records, credentials, and master vector assets. Zero vendor lock-in.
- **Transparent Care Limits**: No misleading claims of "unlimited work" for $100/mo. Deliverables, turnaround times, and hours are defined explicitly. Retainers can be cancelled with 30 days notice.

## Active Projects & Case Studies

- [AquaWay Tours](https://aquaway.tours): Hurghada Red Sea excursion catalog, diving packages, and charter booking platform. Active production website.
- [Awesome Adventure Tours](https://awesomeadventure.tours): Regional tourism portal and operations CRM across Sharm El-Sheikh, Hurghada, and Marsa Alam.
- [Genuine Egypte](https://genuine-egypte.vercel.app): Cultural tour and Nile cruise catalog showcasing private Egypt itineraries.
- [Diamonds ERP](https://bizchefs.com/projects): Private enterprise resource planning blueprint for multi-warehouse inventory and supply chain tracking.

## Technical Architecture

- **Framework**: Next.js 15 App Router with React 19 and TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 with custom dark/light theme tokens
- **Performance**: Sub-second load times, 100% Core Web Vitals target (LCP, INP, CLS)
- **Accessibility**: WCAG 2.2 Level AA compliance
- **Compliance**: Egyptian Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 151/2020), EU GDPR (Regulation EU 2016/679), Google Consent Mode v2
